variants.headline: Home world sends punitive expedition
variants.body: The home world has sent a punitive expedition. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: An expedition with a punitive purpose
variants.body: A punitive expedition has been dispatched by the home world. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.

variants.headline: Distant authority dispatches an expedition
variants.body: The home world has dispatched an expedition intended to punish the colony. Give {target} a fair hearing; outrage alone should not be allowed to write the whole verdict.
